Senior Data Scientist at NexaCorp, focused on leveraging data to drive SaaS growth. Over the past three years, I’ve built scalable machine learning models that improved user retention by 15% and optimized SQL workflows to cut report generation time by 40%. My work with TensorFlow and scikit-learn has enabled predictive analytics pipelines now used across three product lines.  

Collaborating with cross-functional teams, I’ve translated complex data insights into actionable strategies—recently refining a customer segmentation model that increased marketing ROI by 22%. Data visualization with Plotly has been key to making these findings accessible, from interactive dashboards to stakeholder presentations.  

Python remains central to my toolkit, whether automating data pipelines or prototyping new algorithms. I’m constantly refining approaches to ensure models adapt to evolving business needs. The challenge of turning raw data into meaningful impact is what keeps me engaged. Looking ahead, I’m excited to explore how emerging tech can further enhance our data-driven strategies.
